name: Hotel Viata
subject: Furniture reupholstery
body:
Hi Hotel Viata team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We reupholster lobby furniture, banquet and guest-room chairs, and restore leather pieces. We can work in small batches so rooms and event spaces stay open.

If you have pieces that need work, I'd be glad to stop by and take a look. The estimate is free.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Texas Leather Interiors
subject: Warranty and delivery damage repair
body:
Hi Texas Leather Interiors team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather furniture repair shop in Lakeway. When a piece gets damaged in delivery or a customer files a warranty claim, we can usually repair it for less than replacing it. We also touch up floor models.

Who handles service and warranty on your side? I'd like to send them our details.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Luxury Roots
subject: Handbag restoration
body:
Hi Luxury Roots team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, a handbag and leather repair studio in Lakeway. We restore designer bags (Louis Vuitton, Chanel, Gucci and others): edges, handles, corners, lining and color.

If you have bags that need some work before they go on the floor, send me photos and I'll quote them for free. We also have per-bag pricing for resellers.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: Curated Cottage Consignment
subject: Furniture restoration before resale
body:
Hi Curated Cottage Consignment team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather furniture repair shop in Lakeway. Re-covering a dated chair or restoring worn leather often helps a piece sell faster and for more. And when a buyer loves a piece but not the fabric, we can help them with that too.

Would you mind if I left a few cards at your store, with a discount for your buyers?

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com

name: The Good Life Barber Shop
subject: Chair reupholstery
body:
Hi Good Life Barber Shop team,

I'm Dillon with Lerega, an upholstery and leather repair shop in Lakeway. We repair and re-cover cracked vinyl and leather on styling, barber and treatment chairs, so you don't have to replace them, and the chair is out for as short a time as possible.

If you send me a photo of one of the chairs, I'll tell you what it would cost.

Dillon
(737) 247-7484
dillon@lerega.com
